question: **Select the correctly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Suspicion**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correctly spelled word is "**Suspicion**."
 
• The word 'suspicion' is spelt with a single '**s**' after the '**u**'.
 
• It refers to a feeling or belief that someone is guilty of a particular action, typically without evidence or proof. (यह भावना या विश्वास कि कोई व्यक्ति किसी विशेष कार्य के लिए दोषी है, आमतौर पर बिना सबूत या प्रमाण के)
 
 
• **Example**: *She couldn't shake off the suspicion that someone had been going through her personal belongings while she was away.*
 
 
 
• In this context, "**suspicion**" is the correct spelling of the word.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
